'''Tatooine Transit''' was a travel agency that was a member of the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company offered trips to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] on board a fleet of [[Tatooine Transit StarSpeeder 1000|customized]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]]s. At the time, Tatooine Transit operated a [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] terminal on [[Spaceport THX1138]]'s south wing.
